name.ja: 鬼滅模型 竈門禰豆子
name.en: Demon Slayer Model Kit KAMADO NEZUKO

ja: 『鬼滅の刃』より、プラモデル初心者でも簡単に組み立てられる「鬼滅模型」に竈門炭治郎の妹、竈門禰豆子がラインアップ！
■着物の柄やシワに至るまで、こだわりの造形表現で立体化。
■目や眉はライトユーザーでも安心なタンポ印刷で再現。
■髪の“うねり”や“なびき”の様子をパーツ分割により立体的に表現。毛先の色分けは塗装済パーツにより再現している｡
■「鬼滅模型 竈門炭治郎」(別売り)と並べてディスプレイすることで劇中のイメージを演出。
en: From "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba ", Tanjiro Kamado's younger sister, Nezuko Kamado, is now available as a " Demon Slayer" model that can be easily assembled even by plastic model beginners!
• Even the pattern and wrinkles of the kimono have been sculpted into three-dimensional detail.
• Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced with tampo printing that is safe even for light users.
• The “undulations” and “fluttering” of hair are expressed in three dimensions by dividing the parts. The color coding of the tips of the hair is reproduced using painted parts.
• Create an image from the play by displaying it alongside "Demon Slayer Model Kamado Tanjiro" (sold separately).
